source: Biographical details and field notes transcribed from existing FIELDSTOCK backs and club pages. Season statistics use the season index.

spokane-alloys/kellan-brynden.field_note: Keeps a small vial of mound dirt from every ballpark where he earns a win. Each is labeled with the final pitch and given to his father after the season.

spokane-alloys/oskar-svanholm.field_note: Builds small wooden radios during road trips and gives them to clubhouse attendants.

spokane-alloys/mateusz-kasprowicz.field_note: Once finished a rain-delay crossword in ink before the grounds crew removed the tarp.

spokane-alloys/diego-alvarez-mora.field_note: Calls his mother after every start, but refuses to discuss baseball until she brings it up.

spokane-alloys/lukas-havel.field_note: Carries one glove from his first professional season and has repaired it eleven times.

spokane-alloys/caleb-reidman.field_note: Can identify most Inland Northwest birds by sound and keeps a running list by ballpark.

spokane-alloys/sergio-ibarra-lugo.field_note: Learned sleight of hand from an uncle and is banned from dealing clubhouse card games.

spokane-alloys/yaw-mensah.field_note: Orders the same breakfast in every city, then ranks each version in a private spreadsheet.

spokane-alloys/nikolai-dobrynin.field_note: Restores old catcher’s masks and has never sold one from his collection.

spokane-alloys/evan-carroll-iv.field_note: Reads municipal planning documents on flights and remembers unusual zoning disputes.

spokane-alloys/marco-delvecchio.field_note: Maintains a map of the best public staircases in every GLB city.

spokane-alloys/tomasz-kubas.field_note: Was briefly the drummer in a wedding band and still carries sticks in his equipment bag.

spokane-alloys/andres-mireles.field_note: Collects grocery-store receipts from memorable road wins and labels them by final score.

spokane-alloys/wyatt-hollander.field_note: Practices photography from the dugout but rarely photographs the field itself.

spokane-alloys/luis-quinones.field_note: Speaks to his bats in two languages and insists the conversations are strictly professional.

spokane-alloys/pieter-van-wyk.field_note: Has prepared the same pregame sandwich since age nineteen and cuts it into exact thirds.

spokane-alloys/jonah-sato.field_note: Keeps a pocket notebook of every foul ball that reaches the first-base camera well.

spokane-alloys/rene-bouchard.field_note: Re-laces his first baseman's mitt with the same awl he uses to repair fishing creels.

spokane-alloys/malachi-boone.field_note: Can identify every Spokane infield hop by the sound it makes off the dirt.

spokane-alloys/dae-hyun-park.field_note: Marks the warning-track depth in shoe lengths at every park before batting practice.

spokane-alloys/tesfaye-mebrahtu.field_note: Judges fly-ball carry by watching the flags above the right-field light tower.

spokane-alloys/benoit-leduc.field_note: Counts bullpen warmup pitches in French and starts over whenever a ball touches the dirt.

spokane-alloys/hamza-qureshi.field_note: Keeps the resin bag centered on the rubber between innings, even in an empty bullpen.

spokane-alloys/ellis-wren.field_note: Carries a chipped lineup-card pencil from his first professional save.

spokane-alloys/miguel-angel-serrano.field_note: Taps the bullpen gate twice before entering, a habit that began after a scoreless winter-league month.

spokane-alloys/branislav-vukovic.field_note: Folds every completed save sheet into a tiny home plate before filing it away.

monterrey-cementeros/emilio-zendejas.field_note: Marks every bullpen session in a pocket scorebook. A clean inning earns a small pink square.

monterrey-cementeros/masato-yanagisawa.field_note: Rehearses his pickoff footwork on the hotel carpet using two rolled-up socks as bases.

monterrey-cementeros/kofi-mensah.field_note: Keeps a tally of every double play turned with a different second baseman.

monterrey-cementeros/andres-cazares.field_note: Labels batting-practice bats by the outfield gap he is trying to reach that day.
